school: 实证仪器主义（浑天说科学传统与汉赋讽谏传统的混合体）
historical_significance: 张衡（78-139），字平子，南阳西鄂人，东汉文学家、天文学家、数学家、仪器制造家与地方行政官——中国科学史上罕见的'四位一体'人物。他两度出任太史令（115-120、126-133），把一个九品冷署经营成东汉帝国的科学机构：117 年铸成以漏壶水力驱动的浑天仪，让仪器与星空'相应如合符契'；132 年造候风地动仪——八条都中悬铜柱、八向龙机衔丸，138 年陇西地震洛阳无感而西龙吐丸，数日后驿报至，'京师学者咸怪其无征'者'皆服其妙'——这是人类历史上第一次用仪器对地震做出方位正确的事前报告；著《灵宪》明天体，提出'宇之表无极，宙之端无穷'的无限宇宙与月光反射、月食地影诸假说；算得周天十万三千六百八十又十分之五（圆周率约 3.1466）；造指南车、记里鼓车，绘地形图；文学上拟班固《两都》作《二京赋》'精思傅会，十年乃成'，以赋体讽谏奢靡，又作《思玄赋》《归田赋》——后者是中国文学史上第一篇成熟的抒情小赋；他上疏请禁图谶，主张'历数差错，当改从天'——在谶纬满朝的时代把事实认定权交还给观测与验证；崔瑗碑文以'数术穷天地，制作侔造化'总括之。月球背面一座环形山与 1802 号小行星以他的名字命名。
historical_significance_en: Zhang Heng (78-139 CE), courtesy name Pingzi, of Xi'e in Nanyang, was a literary master, astronomer, mathematician, instrument-maker and local administrator of the Eastern Han — a rare 'four-in-one' in Chinese science history. Twice Grand Historian-Astrologer (115-120, 126-133), he ran a ninth-rank bureau into the empire's scientific institution: in 117 he cast the water-driven armillary sphere, the instrument answering the sky 'like matching tallies'; in 132 he built the seismoscope — a central suspended pillar, eight dragons each holding a bronze ball — and in 138, at an earthquake in Longxi unfelt in Luoyang, the western dragon dropped its ball, and when days later the courier report arrived, those who had 'wondered at its want of evidence' 'all acknowledged the marvel' — the first instrument in human history to report an earthquake's direction in advance of the news; his 'Ling Xian' set out the heavens, proposing an infinite universe ('space has no edge; time no beginning') and the hypotheses of reflected moonlight and the earth's shadow in eclipse; he computed the celestial circumference at 1,036,880.5 (pi about 3.1466); he built south-pointing and odometer drum-carts and drew geographic maps; in letters he matched Ban Gu's 'Two Capitals' with his own, 'ten years in the making', admonishing extravagance through the rhapsody, and wrote the 'Rhapsody on Mysterious Speculation' and 'Rhapsody on Returning to the Fields' — the latter the first mature lyric fu in Chinese literary history; he memorialised to prohibit the apocrypha and held 'when the reckoning errs, amend it to follow heaven' — returning the determination of fact to observation and verification in an age of omens; Cui Yuan's epitaph sums him: 'his numbers exhausted heaven and earth; his devices rivalled creation.' A crater on the far side of the Moon and asteroid 1802 bear his name.
unique_thinking: 把'判断'交给会自己运行的装置：仪器会吐丸、学说能被铸成机器、赋体会让过度自现、历数必须对表于天——他一生只在做一个动作：把'谁说了算'从人移交给事——可验证处让事件裁决，不可验证处让源流裁决，外部失效时向内实测——'数术穷天地'的方法论内核是把每一次相信都变成一次可以被检验的暴露
unique_thinking_en: Handing judgment to devices that run themselves: the instrument drops its ball, a doctrine can be cast into a machine, the rhapsody's unfolding reveals excess by its own logic, the calendar must keep time with heaven — his whole life made one move: transferring 'who decides' from men to events — where verifiable, events adjudicate; where unverifiable, provenance adjudicates; when the outer world fails, measure oneself within — the methodological core of 'his numbers exhausted heaven and earth' is turning every belief into an exposure that can be tested
civilization_zh: 东汉的科学与仕途现场：78年生于南阳郡西鄂（今河南南阳）的没落世家——祖父张堪曾任蜀郡太守、有'渔惠'之称而早逝，家道中落，少年张衡自述'不患位之不尊，而患德之不崇；不耻禄之不夥，而耻智之不博'（《应间》）——16岁起游历三辅、观山川风物，95年前后作《温泉赋》；后入洛阳太学，'通五经，贯六艺'；约100年应南阳太守鲍德之邀任主簿，历时九年写成《东京赋》《西京赋》（二京赋），以赋体讽谏奢靡——112年经安帝特征入朝拜郎中，115年迁太史令：自此两度出任太史令（115-120、126-133），执掌天象、历法、卜筮、灵台记事——117年铸成水运浑天仪（以漏壶水力驱动、与天象暗合），132年造候风地动仪（候气与测震的铜制仪器，八个方位各伏铜龙含铜丸，地震时龙口吐丸落入蟾蜍之口、声激而觉）——138年陇西地震，洛阳无感而仪器西向龙口落丸，'京师学者咸怪其无征'，数日后驿报至，'果地震陇西'，于是'皆服其妙'；又作《思玄赋》以寄内省、著《灵宪》以明天体——提出'宇之表无极，宙之端无穷'的无限宇宙论与月光生于日照、月食为地影的假说；计数上推得周天十万三千六百八十又十分之五（圆周率约3.1466）；曾议历法之争（坚持'从天不从人'）、造指南车与记里鼓车（木雕机械传统所系）、绘图而作《地形图》；晚年出为河间相（136-139），治王国'豪右'，'威震郡县'而一年即整肃——139年卒于尚书任上，年六十二；后人以'数术穷天地，制作侔造化'（崔瑗碑文）总括其人——中国科学史上罕见的'文学家-天文学家-仪器制造家-地方官'四位一体样本
civilization_en: The scientific and official life of the Eastern Han court: born in 78 at Xi'e in Nanyang commandery (today's Nanyang, Henan) into a gentry family in decline — his grandfather Zhang Kan had been governor of Shu but died early, the family fell on hard times, and the young Zhang Heng wrote of himself that he 'worried not about rank's lack of honour but about virtue's lack of grandeur; was ashamed not that emolument was small but that knowledge was not broad' ('Yingjian'); from sixteen he travelled the Three Adjuncts, viewing mountains and rivers, composing the 'Rhapsody on the Hot Springs' around 95; he entered the Imperial Academy at Luoyang, 'thorough in the Five Classics, versed in the Six Arts'; around 100 he served nine years as registrar to Bao De, governor of Nanyang, writing there the 'Eastern Capital' and 'Western Capital' rhapsodies satirising extravagance; summoned by Emperor An in 112 as a palace gentleman, in 115 he was promoted Grand Historian-Astrologer (taishi ling) — an office he held twice (115-120, 126-133) over the heavenly signs, the calendar, divination and the records of the Lingtai observatory; in 117 he cast the water-driven armillary sphere, powered by a water-clock and matching the sky; in 132 he built the seismoscope ('the instrument for feeling the winds and earth-movements') — a bronze vessel with eight dragons holding bronze balls in the eight directions, each dropping into a toad's mouth at an earthquake, the sound announcing the bearing; in 138 a quake struck Longxi, unfelt at the capital, yet the western dragon dropped its ball and 'the scholars in the capital all wondered at its lack of evidence' until days later the courier report arrived proving the Longxi earthquake, 'and all acknowledged its marvel'; he also wrote the 'Ling Xian' on the heavens — proposing an infinite universe ('the bounds of space have no edge; the ends of time no beginning') and the hypothesis that moonlight is reflected sunlight and eclipses the earth's shadow; his computations gave the celestial circumference as 1,036,880.5 (pi about 3.1466); he argued in the calendar controversies that one follows heaven, not human preference, built south-pointing-type vehicles and the odometer drum-cart in the woodwork tradition, and drew geographical maps; late in life as chancellor of Hejian (136-139) he awed the powerful clans and cleansed the kingdom in a year; he died in 139 in office as one of the Imperial Secretariat, aged sixty-two; Cui Yuan's epitaph summed him as one who 'exhausted heaven and earth with numbers and matched creation itself with his devices' — a rare four-in-one specimen in Chinese science history: poet, astronomer, instrument-maker, local governor.

modes.name_en: The Method of Verifying by Events
modes.domain_zh: 仪器与实证方法论/把'仪器的预言'与'事件的发生'绑定为同一检验链：仪器可以空转、学说可以自洽，但唯一的裁决者是随后到达的驿报——地动仪的西龙吐丸在洛阳无感时被满朝讥为'无征'，张衡不辩、不修、不撤，只等事件到来：数日后陇西驿报至，争议自动终结——验证不是说服，而是等待事实完成说服
modes.domain_en: Instrumental and empirical methodology / binding an instrument's prediction and the event's occurrence into one chain of test: an instrument may idle and a theory may be self-consistent, but the sole arbiter is the courier report that arrives afterwards — when the western dragon dropped its ball at an earthquake unfelt in Luoyang, the court mocked the 'want of evidence'; Zhang Heng neither argued, nor repaired, nor withdrew, but simply waited for the event: days later the Longxi dispatch arrived and the dispute closed of itself — verification is not persuasion but waiting for facts to finish the persuading
modes.definition_zh: 仪器与实证方法论/公元 138 年那场'京师学者咸怪其无征'的争议，是中国科学史上最干净的一次实证演示：候风地动仪的铜丸落进蟾蜍之口，声音传出的只是一个'西方有地震'的预言——而洛阳城内无人有震感，于是满朝以'无征'责之；张衡的全部方法在此时显形：他不引用自己的官职权威，不诉诸浑天仪的既往成功，不修改预言的方向，甚至不要求别人相信——他只让'事件'走完它的时间；数日后驿马入京，陇西地震的报文与龙口的方位严丝合缝，'于是皆服'——这里的方法论要点有三：其一，预言必须在事件之前公开（事后解释是术数，事前预言是科学）；其二，'无征期'必须完整忍受（在证据到达前接受自己是被讥笑的一方，不提前缩回预言）；其三，验证的标准是事件与预言的对应，而不是多数人的暂信——这套'公开预言-忍受无征-以事裁决'的三步，比弗朗西斯·培根的归纳法早了十五个世纪，而且是用青铜与铜丸、在宫廷政治的眼皮底下完成的；方法论上要求：任何判断都必须在结果揭晓前给出可证伪的形式，任何等待期都不得用修辞填补，任何已公开的预言不得悄悄修改
modes.definition_en: Instrumental and empirical methodology / the controversy of 138 CE — when 'the scholars of the capital all wondered at its want of evidence' — is the cleanest demonstration of empiricism in Chinese science history: the seismoscope's bronze ball dropped into the toad's mouth, announcing only one prediction, 'an earthquake to the west' — yet no one in Luoyang felt a tremor, and the court taxed it as 'no evidence'; Zhang Heng's whole method now showed itself: he did not invoke his office, did not appeal to the armillary sphere's past success, did not revise the direction of the prediction, did not even ask to be believed — he simply let the event complete its time; days later the courier entered the city, the Longxi earthquake report matching the dragon's bearing exactly, 'and all were convinced'; three methodological points: first, the prediction must be public before the event (retrospective explanation is divination; prior prediction is science); second, the 'evidence-free interval' must be endured in full (accept being the mocked party until the evidence arrives, never retracting early); third, the criterion of verification is the correspondence of event to prediction, not majority assent — this three-step of 'public prediction, enduring the interval, letting events judge' predates Francis Bacon by fifteen centuries, wrought in bronze and copper balls under the eyes of court politics; methodologically: every judgment must take falsifiable form before the outcome is revealed, no interval may be papered over with rhetoric, and no published prediction may be quietly revised
modes.source_chapter: 《后汉书·张衡传》：'尝一龙机发而地不觉动，京师学者咸怪其无征，后数日驿至，果地震陇西，于是皆服其妙。'
modes.key_quote_zh: 仪器说了什么，就让事件来回答——在驿马到达之前，谁也不欠谁一个相信；被讥为'无征'的那几天，正是方法与术数分道的地方。
modes.key_quote_en: Let the event answer what the instrument has said — before the courier arrives no one owes anyone belief; those days of being mocked as 'evidence-free' are precisely where method parts ways with divination.
key_concepts: 事前预言 prior prediction（预测必须在事件发生前公开定形——事后解释无论多精巧都只算术数）
prior prediction (a forecast must be publicly fixed before the event; however elegant, retrospective explanation is only divination)
无征期忍受 enduring the evidence-free interval（证据在路上的全部时间都必须忍受被讥笑——提前缩回预言等于从未预言）
enduring the evidence-free interval (the entire time evidence is on the road must be endured as the mocked party — an early retraction erases the prediction)
事件裁决 event as arbiter（争议的终点是事件与预言的对应，不是辩论的胜负——驿报比雄辩高一级）
the event as arbiter (a dispute ends at the correspondence of event to prediction, not at victory in debate — the courier outranks eloquence)
不辩之辩 the debate without arguing（不引权威、不修预言、不求人信——把说服的成本全部转移给事实）
the debate without arguing (invoke no authority, revise no prediction, beg no belief — shift the whole cost of persuasion onto the facts)
process_zh: 把判断转写为可证伪的预言：明确'何时、何地、发生什么'三要素，并在结果揭晓前公之于相关者
预设无征期：估计证据到达的合理时滞，宣告在此期间不撤回、不修改、不补充预言
忍受与记录：无征期内承受一切质疑但不做任何修辞辩护，同时记录下每一次质疑的原话与时间
事件到达即结算：对应则公示对应细节，不对应则公开认错并修正仪器或学说——结算永远从严于己不利处
process_en: Transcribe every judgment into a falsifiable prediction: specify when, where, what, and publish it to the concerned parties before the outcome
Pre-set the evidence-free interval: estimate the realistic lag of evidence arriving, and declare no retraction, revision or addition within it
Endure and record: bear every challenge during the interval without rhetorical defence, while logging each challenge verbatim with its time
Settle when the event arrives: if it matches, publish the matching details; if not, admit the miss in public and revise the instrument or theory — settlement always stricter against oneself
representative_cases_zh: 138 年陇西地震与铜丸落蟾（'京师学者咸怪其无征'的完整案例）：地动仪西向龙口吐丸而洛阳无感——张衡不发一言等待驿报，'后数日驿至，果地震陇西，于是皆服其妙'——中国史册里罕见的'预言-等待-验证'三段完整闭环
浑天仪的暗合检验：117 年铸水运浑天仪后，他以'与天相应，如合符契'为验收标准——让室内仪器与室外星空长期对表，凡室中星与天上星出现或隐没时，'历历然如符契'——仪器不是一次性的成就，而是要经受持续对表的日常检验
历法之争中'从天不从人'的立场：与廷议争历时，他反对以政治需要改历，主张以实测天象为唯一依据——把'历家之谬'交还给'天'来裁决而非交还给人来表决
representative_cases_en: The Longxi earthquake and the ball dropping into the toad (138 CE, the complete case): the western dragon dropped its ball at a quake unfelt in Luoyang — Zhang Heng said not a word and waited for the courier; 'days later the dispatch came, an earthquake in Longxi indeed, and all acknowledged the marvel' — a rare full closed loop of prediction, waiting and verification in the Chinese record

The armillary sphere's standing cross-check: after casting the water-driven sphere in 117 he took 'correspondence with heaven, like tallies matching' as the acceptance criterion — keeping the indoor instrument in continuous comparison with the outdoor sky, stars appearing and vanishing in the chamber 'point for point as matching tallies' — an instrument is not a one-time achievement but a daily test by standing comparison

The calendar controversy and 'following heaven, not men': in debates over the calendar he opposed changing it for political convenience, holding measured celestial phenomena the sole basis — returning 'the errors of the calendarists' to the sky for judgment rather than to men for a vote
modern_applications_zh: 产品与技术路线的'路标式验证'：把技术判断写成'某月某日某指标达到某值'的公开路标，路标期不撤回不改口——团队信誉由路标兑现史积累，而非由汇报 PPT 积累
投资与研究决策的'无征期纪律'：买入或立项后设置明确的验证窗口与认错条款，窗口期内禁止用新叙事填补旧判断的空洞——'预测不改口'是区分投资人与赌徒的装置
组织决策的'驿报机制'：任何争议先约定'什么证据到达即停止争论'——把裁决权从层级与口才移交给事前约定的证据到达事件
modern_applications_en: Milestone-style verification for products and technical bets: write each technical judgment as a public milestone — 'metric X reaches value Y by date Z' — never retracted within its window; a team's credibility accrues from milestone history, not from decks

The evidence-free-interval discipline in investing and research: after buying in or launching, set an explicit verification window and pre-declared error terms; within the window no new narrative may fill the hole of the old judgment — 'no mid-window revisions' is the device separating investors from gamblers

The courier mechanism in organisational decisions: for every dispute, agree first on 'what evidence, on arrival, ends the argument' — handing adjudication from hierarchy and eloquence to the pre-agreed arrival of evidence

modes.name_en: The Method of Driving Heaven by Water
modes.category: 科学方法论/仪器宇宙论
modes.domain_zh: 仪器制造方法论/把'宇宙的运行'翻译成'可由水力持续驱动的机械'：浑天仪不是天象的图解而是天象的模拟机——以漏壶的恒定水流代替不可见的天枢，让铜球在自己屋里按天的节奏转动；仪器的最高验收标准不是形似而是'与天相应，如合符契'——人造物与宇宙对表
modes.domain_en: Instrument-making methodology / translating the running of the cosmos into machinery that water can drive without pause: the armillary sphere is not a diagram of the heavens but a simulator of them — the constant flow of a water-clock stands in for the invisible celestial pivot, and the bronze sphere turns indoors at the sky's own rhythm; the instrument's highest acceptance criterion is not likeness but 'correspondence with heaven, like matching tallies' — a made thing keeping time with the universe
modes.definition_zh: 仪器制造方法论/汉代宇宙论三派（盖天、浑天、宣夜）本是可以永远争论下去的学说——张衡的方法不是赢得辩论，而是把浑天说'做成机器'：117 年他以漏壶水流驱动铜制浑天仪，让仪器的转动与真实星空同步，'室中之星与天上之星相应，如合符契'；这一步的哲学含义是：学说之间的争论无法用修辞终结，但可以被'哪个学说能被制成运转的机器'这一制作问题短路——浑天说能被水力驱动并持续对表成功，盖天说不能，争论就此结束；更深一层，'以水运天'把'永恒而不可及的天'转写为'恒定而可调的水'——宇宙的规律性被还原为一个工程参数（水流的均匀性），而工程参数是可以被改进的：漏壶的刻漏技术由此与天文观测互为因果；方法论上要求：把抽象主张转写为可运转模型，把模型与实在的长期对表作为唯一验收标准，并持续改进驱动模型的'能量源'本身
modes.definition_en: Instrument-making methodology / the three schools of Han cosmology (Gaitian,huntian, Xuanye) could have debated forever — Zhang Heng's method was not to win the debate but to 'make the huntian theory into a machine': in 117 he drove a bronze armillary sphere with the flow of a water-clock, its turning synchronised with the real sky, 'the stars in the chamber answering the stars in heaven, like matching tallies'; the philosophical import: disputes between doctrines cannot be closed by rhetoric, but can be short-circuited by the question of which doctrine can be built into a running machine — the huntian could be water-driven and pass standing comparison, the gaitian could not, and the argument ended; deeper still, 'driving heaven by water' transcribes the eternal, unreachable sky into constant, adjustable water — the regularity of the cosmos is reduced to an engineering parameter (the evenness of flow), and engineering parameters can be improved: clepsydra technique and astronomical observation henceforth drive each other; methodologically: transcribe abstract claims into running models, take long-run comparison of model against reality as the sole acceptance test, and keep improving the model's own energy source
modes.source_chapter: 《晋书·天文志》引张衡《浑天仪注》：'浑天如鸡子，天体圆如弹丸，地如鸡中黄……'；灵台对表记录：'室中星与天上相应，如合符契'
modes.key_quote_zh: 学说赢不赢不重要，能造出来并且跟得上天的那个学说自动获胜——把宇宙装进一台水力机器，是哲学能打出的最硬的牌。
modes.key_quote_en: What matters is not which doctrine wins the debate but which can be built and keep pace with the sky — putting the cosmos inside a water-driven machine is the hardest move philosophy can play.
key_concepts: 模型短路争论 the model that short-circuits debate（学说之争可以被'能否制成运转机器'短路——能造的是真，不能造的是谈资）
the model that short-circuits debate (doctrinal disputes are short-circuited by whether the doctrine can be built into a running machine — the buildable is true, the unbuildable a talking point)
以恒定代不可见 constancy for the invisible（用漏壶水流的恒定代替天枢的不可见——把宇宙的规律性还原为可改进的工程参数）
constancy for the invisible (the even flow of the clepsydra stands in for the unseen celestial pivot — cosmic regularity reduced to an improvable engineering parameter)
合符契验收 the matching-tallies criterion（仪器的验收标准是与天的长期对表，不是一次性的演示——'如合符契'是持续状态而非瞬间）
the matching-tallies criterion (an instrument is accepted by long-run comparison with the sky, not a one-off demonstration — 'like matching tallies' is a standing state, not an instant)
能量源即认识论 the energy source as epistemology（驱动模型的动力品质决定模型的认识品质——水流越均匀，天象越可预言）
the energy source as epistemology (the quality of what drives the model decides the quality of what the model knows — the more even the flow, the more predictable the sky)
process_zh: 把对立学说各自转写为可运转模型：给每个学说找一个'如果它是真的，就能造出什么机器'的制作问题
为模型选择恒定能量源：找出驱动模型所需的'水流'——那些可以被稳定供给、被测量、被改进的输入
长期对表：让模型与实在持续并排运行，记录每一次对应与偏差——验收标准是长期吻合率而非演示效果
把改进回流到能量源：对表暴露的偏差先修'水'（输入品质），再修'机器'（结构）——能量源的改进史就是模型精度的改进史
process_en: Transcribe rival doctrines into runnable models: pose each doctrine the making-question 'if it were true, what machine could it produce?'
Choose a constant energy source for the model: find the 'water' that drives it — inputs that can be steadily supplied, measured and improved
Keep the standing comparison: run the model alongside reality and log every correspondence and deviation — accept on long-run match rate, not on demonstration effect

Flow improvements back to the energy source: deviations shown by comparison are fixed first in the 'water' (input quality), then in the 'machine' (structure) — the history of energy-source improvement is the history of model accuracy
representative_cases_zh: 117 年铸成水运浑天仪：以漏壶水力驱动铜仪，'与天相应，如合符契'——浑天说从学说变成机器，盖天说的争论地位随之瓦解；这是中国历史上第一次'用工程短路哲学争论'的完整案例
漏壶与浑仪的互相成就：为了让天的模拟更准，他必须让水更稳——汉代刻漏的补偿技术（多级漏壶以平滑流量）在天文需求牵引下成熟，'能量的品质'与'认识的品质'同一条曲线上升
《灵宪》的天体假说与仪器互证：《灵宪》提出月光生于日照、月食为地影——这些假说与浑天仪的对表记录互为支撑，学说、机器、观测三者在同一验证链上
representative_cases_en: The water-driven armillary sphere of 117: bronze driven by clepsydra flow, 'answering heaven like matching tallies' — the huntian theory became a machine and the gaitian debate collapsed; the first complete Chinese case of short-circuiting a philosophical dispute with engineering

Clepsydra and sphere making each other: to simulate heaven accurately he had to steady the water — multi-stage clepsydra flow-compensation matured under astronomical demand, the quality of energy and the quality of knowledge climbing the same curve

The 'Ling Xian' hypotheses cross-validated by instruments: moonlight as reflected sunlight and eclipses as the earth's shadow — hypotheses propped by the sphere's comparison records, doctrine, machine and observation on one chain of verification
modern_applications_zh: 竞争性技术路线的'原型裁决法'：路线之争不在会议上解决而在原型机上解决——给每条路线一个可运转原型与统一验收指标，让长期对表数据决定路线存亡
基础设施即认识论：把'驱动模型的水流'（数据管道、算力、资金流）当作认识品质的第一性参数来投资——模型精度问题常常是输入稳定性问题
哲学争论的产品化终结：公司愿景之争以'哪个愿景能被做成持续运行并过验收的产品'收束——能运转的愿景赢，不能运转的愿景进入故事集
modern_applications_en: The prototype verdict for rival technical routes: route disputes are settled not in meetings but on prototype rigs — give each route a running prototype and a common acceptance metric, and let long-run comparison data decide survival

Infrastructure as epistemology: invest in the 'water that drives the model' (data pipelines, compute, funding flows) as the first-order parameter of knowledge quality — model-accuracy problems are often input-stability problems

Ending vision debates by productisation: a company's vision disputes close with 'which vision can be built into a product that runs and passes acceptance' — the runnable vision wins, the unrunnable joins the story collection
representative_figures: 张衡（核心）
威廉·汤姆孙（开尔文）与潮汐谐波分析仪（平行参照：把海洋的节律转写为可由曲柄驱动的机械求和器——同样'以机器代论战'）
侯风地动仪之后的郭守敬（继承参照：简仪与授时历——把'对表验收'做到明代以前最高精度）

modes.name_en: The Method of Critique Woven in Rhapsody
modes.category: 政治沟通方法论/体制内言说
modes.domain_zh: 体制内言说方法论/把'不该直说的话'编织进'必须被赞美的体裁'：二京赋以千言铺陈帝国繁华，繁华铺陈到极致处让对象自己看见自己的过度——讽谏不指向具体的人而指向被赞美的结构本身；言说者的安全与批评的锋利由体裁的形式要求同时担保
modes.domain_en: In-system communication methodology / weaving 'what must not be said plainly' into 'a genre that must be praised': the two-capital rhapsodies spend a thousand lines unfolding imperial splendour, and at the very apex of the unfolding let the beholder see his own excess — the critique points at no person but at the very structure being praised; the speaker's safety and the critique's edge are both guaranteed by the formal demands of the genre
modes.definition_zh: 体制内言说方法论/东汉宫廷的言说环境是：直谏者死、谀颂者荣、沉默者安——张衡的答案是第四条路：把批评织进颂体本身；《二京赋》十年乃成，全文以铺陈帝国成就开篇、层层加码到穷奢极欲的顶点，然后在顶点处借'凭虚公子'与'安处先生'的对答完成转折——被赞美的对象在赞美的高潮里第一次看清自己的过度；这一方法的形式诀窍是'让体裁替自己冒险'：赋必须铺陈，铺陈必须登峰，登峰处必然显出过度——批评不是言说者外加的，而是体裁逻辑内生的；与他的地动仪同构：二者的本质都是'把判断交给一个自身会运行的装置'（仪器会吐丸，赋体会显过度），言说者只负责建好装置然后退开；方法论上要求：找到体制'必须收下'的言说形式，让批评内生于形式自身的逻辑，并把转折点放在接受者防御最薄弱的位置（被赞美的顶点）
modes.definition_en: In-system communication methodology / the Eastern Han court allowed three speeches: the plainly critical (fatal), the flattering (honoured), the silent (safe) — Zhang Heng found a fourth: weaving critique into the very fabric of praise; ten years in the making, the 'Two Capitals' rhapsody opens by unfolding imperial achievement line upon line, ascending to the summit of extravagance, where — through the dialogue of Master No-Such and Sir Dwelling-in-Peace — the turn arrives: the praised object, at the climax of its own praise, first sees its own excess; the formal trick is 'letting the genre take the risk': a fu must unfold, unfolding must reach the peak, and at the peak excess shows itself — the critique is not added by the speaker but generated by the genre's own logic; isomorphic with his seismoscope: both are devices that run themselves and render the verdict (the instrument drops its ball, the genre reveals excess), the speaker merely builds the device and steps back; methodologically: find the speech-form the system is obliged to receive, let critique grow from the form's own logic, and place the turning point where the receiver's defences are thinnest — the apex of his own praise
modes.source_chapter: 《后汉书·张衡传》：'衡乃拟班固《两都》，作《二京赋》，因以讽谏。精思傅会，十年乃成。'
modes.key_quote_zh: 颂词铺到最高处，过度自己会从铺陈里探出头来——让体裁替你冒险，比让自己冒险高明得多。
modes.key_quote_en: Lay the praise high enough and the excess will poke its head out of the unfolding — letting the genre take the risk is far wiser than taking it yourself.
key_concepts: 内生批评 endogenous critique（批评不是外加的判词而是体裁逻辑的必然产物——铺陈登峰处过度自现）
endogenous critique (criticism is not an appended verdict but a necessary product of the genre's logic — at the summit of unfolding, excess appears of itself)
必须收下的形式 the form the system must accept（选择体制职责内的言说体裁——颂与赋不可拒绝，批评搭它们的便车入城）
the form the system must accept (choose the speech-genre that is the system's duty to receive — praise and rhapsody cannot be refused, and critique rides them through the gate)
装置化言说 speech as device（判断交给自身会运行的装置——仪器吐丸、赋体显过度，言说者建好即退开）
speech as device (hand the verdict to a device that runs itself — the instrument drops its ball, the rhapsody reveals excess; the speaker builds and withdraws)
顶点转折 the turn at the apex（转折放在防御最薄处：被赞美的高潮——那里没有理由怀疑，所以那里看见得最深）
the turn at the apex (place the reversal where defences are thinnest: the climax of praise — no one suspects it there, so it is seen most deeply there)
process_zh: 盘点体制'必须收下'的言说形式：找出职责要求的、不可拒绝的表达载体（报告、贺词、庆典、行业文体）
在形式内部做足'形式的义务'：把赞美、铺陈、数据写到无可挑剔——形式越合格，内生的批评越不可指摘
设计内生转折：让形式的逻辑自身（铺陈的极限、数据的排列、流程的推演）产生那个'让过度自现'的瞬间
转折后立即归还安全：把结论留在形式的常规框架内（建议、祝颂、存目），不追加人身的锋芒——体裁冒的险不必让作者再冒一次
process_en: Inventory the speech-forms the system must accept: find the expression vehicles its duties require and cannot refuse (reports, congratulatory addresses, ceremonies, professional genres)
Discharge the form's obligations to the full: bring the praise, the unfolding, the data past reproach — the fitter the form, the more unimpeachable its endogenous critique
Design the endogenous turn: let the form's own logic — the limit of unfolding, the arrangement of data, the deduction of a process — produce the moment when excess shows itself

Return to safety at once after the turn: leave the conclusion inside the genre's regular frame (recommendations, good wishes, for the record), adding no personal edge — what the genre risked need not be risked again by the author
representative_cases_zh: 《二京赋》十年乃成的完整示范：拟班固《两都》而'因以讽谏'——铺陈东京西京的礼制、物产、宫室、游猎至穷奢极欲，然后借'安处先生'批评'奢未及侈，俭而不陋'的分寸论，完成对整个帝国消费结构的整体批评；汉赋至此从宫廷装饰变成帝国的镜子
《思玄赋》的另一极：当赋体讽谏的对象从'朝廷'转向'自己的处境'——以远游求索、问卜天地的方式安放政治失意，同一方法向内运转：铺陈困惑至极处，答案自己浮现
《归田赋》的形式逃逸：当讽谏空间最终关闭（顺帝朝宦官当政），他以史上第一篇成熟的抒情小赋退出铺陈传统——形式方法论的最后一课：连体裁本身也可以被更换，而不必更换人格
representative_cases_en: The complete demonstration of the 'Two Capitals' rhapsody, ten years in the making: modelled on Ban Gu's 'Two Capitals' yet 'thereby offering admonition' — unfolding the rites, produce, palaces and hunts of the two capitals to the summit of extravagance, then letting Sir Dwelling-in-Peace argue the doctrine of measure, 'extravagant yet not wasteful, frugal yet not shabby' — a total critique of the empire's consumption structure; the fu became, from then on, the mirror of the empire rather than its ornament

The other pole, the 'Rhapsody on Mysterious Speculation': when the object of critique shifts from court to his own plight — settling political disappointment through a visionary journey and questions put to heaven and oracle — the same method running inward: unfold the perplexity to its limit and the answer surfaces of itself

The formal escape of 'Rhapsody on Returning to the Fields': when the space for admonition finally closed (the eunuchs' ascendancy under Emperor Shun), he withdrew from the unfolding tradition in the first mature lyric fu — the last lesson of formal method: the genre itself may be changed without changing the character
modern_applications_zh: 组织年报复盘与'数据型批评'：把问题埋进必须被呈报的数据铺陈自身——排序、趋势与对照的排列让过度自现，结论只写建议不写追责
对上沟通的'贺信式纠偏'：在必须歌功颂德的场合（周年庆、里程碑、立项仪式），让铺陈的指标自身暴露边界条件——'恭喜达到一百万人'的铺陈里自然长出'第二年的留存拐点'
职业转型的'体裁更换法'：当体制内言说空间关闭，更换体裁（从内部谏言到公开写作、从铺陈到极简）而不是更换立场——人格连续，形式翻新
modern_applications_en: Data-borne critique in annual reviews: bury the problems in the very arrays of data that must be reported — ordering, trends and contrasts let excess show itself, and the conclusion carries recommendations, not blame

Congratulatory-course-correction for upward communication: at obligatory celebrations (anniversaries, milestones, project launches), let the heralded metrics expose their own boundary conditions — from the unfolding of 'a million users' grows 'next year's retention inflection'

The genre change in career transitions: when in-system speech closes, change the genre (from internal memo to public writing, from unfolding to minimalism) rather than the position — character continuous, form renewed
representative_figures: 张衡（核心）
司马迁（先例参照：以'史'为体裁把批评织进叙事——同样让体裁承担冒险，本人付出代价后体裁成典）
伏尔泰（平行参照：以小说体式完成政论批判——《老实人》之于教会，如《二京赋》之于汉廷）

modes.name_en: The Method of Suspended Judgment on Signs
modes.domain_zh: 认识论方法论/对'无验证手段的断言'悬置而非否定：太史令的职责包含卜筮与妖言奏报，但张衡上疏要求'收拾图谶，一禁绝之'——图谶之学满朝信奉而无法验证，他的处理不是证明其为伪（无法证明），而是论证'此非圣人之言'并主张明令禁绝；在可验证领域以事裁决，在不可验证领域以源流裁决——两套标准绝不互相污染
modes.domain_en: Epistemological methodology / suspending rather than denying claims that lack any means of verification: the Grand Historian's office included divination and the reporting of portents, yet Zhang Heng memorialised to 'collect the apocryphal charts and prohibit them outright' — apocryphal learning was believed throughout the court but could not be tested; his move was not to prove it false (unprovable) but to argue 'this is not the word of the sages' and to demand its prohibition by edict; in the verifiable realm, events judge; in the unverifiable, provenance judges — the two standards never contaminate each other
modes.definition_zh: 认识论方法论/张衡的处境是所有科学史家的噩梦原型：他的官职（太史令）一半是科学家一半是术士——职责同时包含观测天象与奏报符命；他与图谶之学的斗争（133 年前后两次上疏）不是简单的'反迷信'，而是一次精密的认识论切割：图谶宣称是圣人（孔子）预言汉朝命运的密码文本，满朝以之定礼制、断封赏，张衡的攻击点选在'源流'而非'内容'——他指出图谶成于哀平之际、'众儒鬻名'互相杜撰，其篇目与经典不合、其文字与圣人不合，故'此皆欺世罔俗，以昧势位'——他不浪费一个字去证明谶语为伪（不可证伪者不可证伪），只论证它不是它自称的东西；同时他对可验证的领域（历法、天象、地震）坚持'验之以事'；这就是'无征存疑法'：可验证处以事件为裁决，不可验证处以来源为裁决，中间地带（暂时无验证手段的假说，如月光反射论）以'存而不论'的方式保持开放；方法论上要求：先给每个断言分类（可验证/不可验证），再选裁决方式，绝不因一类裁决有效就把它越界使用
modes.definition_en: Epistemological methodology / Zhang Heng's situation is the prototype of every historian of science's nightmare: his office (Grand Historian-Astrologer) was half scientist, half augur — its duties covering both the observation of heaven and the reporting of omens; his fight against apocryphal learning (two memorials around 133) was not simple 'anti-superstition' but a precise epistemological dissection: the apocrypha claimed to be cipher-texts of the sages (Confucius) foretelling the Han's destiny, trusted across the court to settle rites and rewards; Zhang Heng's point of attack was provenance, not content — he showed the apocrypha arose in the reigns of Ai and Ping, 'scholars peddling names' inventing one another's texts, their catalogues at variance with the classics, their language at variance with the sages, hence 'all deceits against the world and its customs, blinding men to position and power' — he did not spend one word proving the prophecies false (the unfalsifiable cannot be falsified) but only that they were not what they claimed to be; meanwhile, in the verifiable realm — calendars, sky, earthquakes — he held to 'letting events judge'; this is the method of suspended judgment on signs: in the verifiable, events adjudicate; in the unverifiable, provenance adjudicates; the middle realm (hypotheses with no test yet, like reflected moonlight) stays open under 'affirmed but not settled'; methodologically: classify every assertion first (verifiable or not), then choose its mode of adjudication, and never let a mode valid in one class cross the boundary
modes.source_chapter: 《后汉书·张衡传》载其上疏：'图谶虚妄，非圣人之法'……'宜收藏图谶，一禁绝之'；又《请禁绝图谶疏》：'此皆欺世罔俗，以昧势位'。
modes.key_quote_zh: 对没法验证的东西，不必证明它假，只需指出它不是它自称的东西——图谶的问题不是错，是'冒充圣人'；把裁决权还给可验证的世界。
modes.key_quote_en: For what cannot be tested, no need to prove it false — only to show it is not what it claims to be; the trouble with the apocrypha is not error but impersonation of the sages; return adjudication to the testable world.
key_concepts: 源流裁决 provenance as adjudicator（不可验证的断言以其自称的来源为裁决点——冒充圣人者不必被证明假，只需被证明不是圣人）
provenance as adjudicator (an unverifiable claim is judged at its claimed source — an impersonator of the sages need not be proven false, only proven not a sage)
双轨不污染 two rails, no cross-contamination（可验证领域用事件裁决、不可验证领域用源流裁决——任何一轨的裁决方式不得越界使用）
two rails, no cross-contamination (events adjudicate the verifiable, provenance the unverifiable — neither mode may cross the boundary)
存而不论 affirmed but not settled（对暂无验证手段的假说保持开放记录——既不信也不弃，等待验证手段的到来）
affirmed but not settled (hypotheses with no test yet stay open on the record — neither believed nor discarded, awaiting the arrival of a test)
请求明令 the request for an edict（对无法逐条驳斥的系统性伪学，诉求从'说服每个人'升级为'请求制度性禁绝'）
the request for an edict (against systematic pseudo-learning that cannot be refuted item by item, escalate from persuading individuals to petitioning institutional prohibition)
process_zh: 给断言分类：每个进入视野的主张先标注'可验证/不可验证/暂不可验证'——分类本身就是认识论动作
可验证者入验证链：转写为事前预言，接受事件裁决（见验之以事法）
不可验证者查源流：追问'它自称什么来源'并检验来源的真伪——伪造的来源一经确证，断言整体降级为冒充
暂不可验证者建档：记录假说内容、支持理由与反例条件，定期复查是否有新验证手段到达——档案是开放的，裁决是延期的
process_en: Classify assertions: mark every claim entering view as verifiable, unverifiable, or not-yet-verifiable — the classification is itself the epistemic act
Send the verifiable down the verification chain: transcribe into prior predictions and let events adjudicate (the method of verifying by events)
Trace provenance for the unverifiable: ask 'what does it claim as its source' and test the source — a forged source once established demotes the whole claim to impersonation

Archive the not-yet-verifiable: record the hypothesis, its supporting reasons and its disconfirming conditions, and re-check periodically for the arrival of new tests — the archive open, the verdict deferred
representative_cases_zh: 《请禁绝图谶疏》的完整论证：不驳谶语内容而查谶书出身——'图谶成于哀平之际'、篇目与《诗》《书》不合、文字'虽有点窃，弗协经训'——结论'此皆欺世罔俗'，诉求直接是'一禁绝之'；这是中国史上罕见的'以文献学消灭伪科学'的范例：伪造的来源比错误的内容更容易一击致命
与历法之争的对照：同一年代他主张历法'从天不从人'——历法可验证故以实测裁决，谶纬不可验证故以源流裁决——同一个人在同一朝堂执行两套互不污染的标准
《灵宪》里的'存而不论'：月光反射与地影致月食是当时无法直接验证的假说，他以几何推演陈述之而不宣称已证——假说与结论在同一文本中被明确分层
representative_cases_en: The complete argument of the 'Memorial to Prohibit the Apocrypha': not refuting the prophecies' content but auditing their origin — 'the apocrypha arose in the reigns of Ai and Ping', their catalogues clashing with the Odes and Documents, their language 'plundering scraps yet not according with the classics' — concluding 'all deceits against the world' and petitioning outright prohibition; a rare Chinese paradigm of killing pseudo-science by philology: a forged source is more lethal than an erroneous content

The contrast with the calendar controversy: in the same years he held the calendar must 'follow heaven, not men' — the calendar being verifiable is adjudicated by measurement, the apocrypha being unverifiable by provenance — one man, one court, two standards without cross-contamination

'Affirmed but not settled' in the 'Ling Xian': moonlight as reflected light and eclipses as the earth's shadow were untestable hypotheses of the day; he stated them by geometric inference without claiming proof — hypothesis and conclusion explicitly tiered within one text
modern_applications_zh: 商业与科研中的'来源审计'：面对无法验证的宏大叙事（市场预言、竞品传说），不与其内容辩论，而审计其声称的来源——伪造来源一经证实，整套叙事失效
决策领域的'双轨裁决'：可实验的主张进 A/B 验证链，不可实验的主张进来源与利益审计——禁止把 A/B 结果用于不可验证问题，也禁止用权威为可验证问题背书
个人认知的'档案区'：为暂无验证手段的重要假说建立显式档案（记录、反例条件、复查周期）——既不轻信也不武断弃置，等验证手段到来再裁决
modern_applications_en: Provenance audit in business and research: confronted with unverifiable grand narratives (market prophecies, competitor lore), do not debate their content — audit their claimed sources; a forged source once proven collapses the whole narrative

Two-rail adjudication in decision-making: testable claims go down the A/B chain, untestable claims to source-and-incentive audit — never apply A/B results to untestable questions, never let authority underwrite testable ones

A personal 'archive zone' for important hypotheses lacking tests: explicit records with disconfirming conditions and review cycles — neither lightly believed nor rashly discarded, adjudicated when the test arrives
representative_figures: 张衡（核心）
崔述（平行参照：以文献考据驱疑古——同样'攻击来源而非内容'的考据传统先声）
卡尔·波普尔（平行参照：可证伪性划界——张衡以'可验证/不可验证'划界早波普尔十八个世纪）

modes.domain_zh: 校准方法论/把'正确'定义为'与参照系统持续吻合'而非'一次成功'：浑天仪要天天与星空对表，历法要岁岁与天象对表，仪器与学说都必须活在'对表关系'里——正确不是资产而是需要持续支付的维护成本；对表暴露的每一处偏差都先归因于参照系的品质，再归因于自身
modes.domain_en: Calibration methodology / defining 'correct' as 'continuous agreement with a reference system' rather than 'one-time success': the armillary sphere must be compared with the sky daily, the calendar with the heavens yearly — instruments and theories live inside a standing relation of comparison; correctness is not an asset but a maintenance cost paid continuously, and every deviation exposed by comparison is attributed first to the reference's quality, then to oneself
modes.definition_zh: 校准方法论/'与天相应，如合符契'这句话常被读作一次性的成功记录，但张衡的方法论重心在'如'字背后的持续关系：浑天仪铸成之日不是工程终点，而是对表关系的开始——此后每一天，室中的仪器与室外的天空都在被并排检验；这个方法的现代对应物是'校准'概念：任何测量系统的正确性都随时间漂移，必须被持续比对、持续归因、持续修正；张衡的独特处在于对表的双向性——偏差出现时先问'参照系本身的品质够不够'（水流还均匀吗、刻漏还准吗），再问'仪器漂了多少'：能量源与仪器共同承担误差，而不是把误差全部记在仪器的账上；同样地，历法之争中他的立场'历数差错，当改从天'——历法对表的参照系是天象本身而非祖制或政治需要；方法论上要求：为每个判断系统指定明确的参照系，建立定期对表机制，偏差归因先外后内（先查参照系品质再查自身），并把对表记录本身作为系统改进的一级数据
modes.definition_en: Calibration methodology / the phrase 'answering heaven like matching tallies' is often read as a one-time success record, but the methodological weight lies in the standing relation behind 'answering': the day the sphere was cast was not the end of the engineering but the beginning of the comparison — every day after, the instrument indoors and the sky outdoors stood side by side under test; the modern counterpart is the concept of calibration: any measuring system drifts and must be continuously compared, attributed and corrected; Zhang Heng's distinctiveness is the bidirectionality of comparison — when deviation appears, first ask 'is the reference itself up to quality' (is the water still even, the clepsydra still true), then 'how far has the instrument drifted': energy source and instrument share the error, rather than all of it booked to the instrument; likewise in the calendar controversy his position — 'when the reckoning errs, amend it to follow heaven' — the calendar's reference is the sky itself, not ancestral precedent or political need; methodologically: assign every judgment system an explicit reference, institute scheduled comparison, attribute deviations outside-in (reference quality before self), and make the comparison records themselves first-order data for improving the system
modes.source_chapter: 《晋书·天文志》载浑天仪'与天相应，如合符契'；《后汉书》历议：'历数差错，当改从天。'
modes.key_quote_zh: 正确不是建成那一天的成就，是每一天都得重新支付的账单——对表的记录比仪器本身更接近真理。
modes.key_quote_en: Correctness is not the achievement of completion day but a bill paid again every day — the record of comparison lies closer to truth than the instrument itself.
key_concepts: 正确即持续吻合 correctness as continuous agreement（正确不是一次性证书而是维护状态——停止对表的那一刻正确性开始蒸发）
correctness as continuous agreement (correctness is not a certificate but a maintained state — from the moment comparison stops, it evaporates)
偏差双向归因 bidirectional attribution（误差先记参照系后记自身——水流不匀与仪器漂移分担责任，避免把系统性问题记成个体错误）

bidirectional attribution (error booked first to the reference, then to the self — uneven water and instrument drift share responsibility, keeping systemic problems from being booked as individual ones)
参照系唯一性 the singularity of the reference（对表的参照系必须是'天'本身而非祖制、权威或多数——参照系一旦可以协商，对表就变成表演）
the singularity of the reference (the reference must be the sky itself, not precedent, authority or majority — once the reference is negotiable, comparison becomes theatre)
记录即数据 the record as data（对表记录本身是一级数据——偏差的时间序列比任何单次读数更接近系统真相）
the record as data (comparison records are first-order data — the time series of deviations approaches systemic truth better than any single reading)
process_zh: 指定参照系：为每个判断系统明确写出'与什么对表'——参照系必须不可协商、可长期获得、品质可审计
建立对表节律：规定对表频率（日对表/年对表/事件触发对表）与记录格式——对表未被安排就等于未被实施
双向归因：每次偏差先评估参照系品质（能量源、基准、基准的基准），再评估自身漂移——归因顺序写进流程不许颠倒
让记录回流：偏差时间序列定期汇总为系统改进输入——对表不只是验收，是对表记录本身在教系统变准
process_en: Name the reference: write down explicitly what each judgment system compares against — a reference that is non-negotiable, durably available, and auditable in quality
Set the rhythm of comparison: schedule frequency (daily, yearly, event-triggered) and record format — unscheduled comparison is unimplemented comparison
Attribute bidirectionally: for each deviation assess reference quality first (energy source, benchmark, the benchmark's benchmark), then one's own drift — the order fixed in process, never reversed
Let records flow back: summarise deviation time series periodically as input to system improvement — comparison is not acceptance only; the records themselves teach the system accuracy
representative_cases_zh: 浑天仪的日常对表：铸成后'室中之星与天上之星相应'——仪器与星空并排运行成为常态工程，而非一次性验收；这是中国仪器史上第一个把'持续校准'写进设计目标的装置
历法之争的'当改从天'：历法偏离天象时他主张改历而非辩护——参照系（天象）高于参照系的使用史（旧历）；'改历'在他那里不是失败而是对表机制的正常运转
漏壶的多级补偿：对表暴露的偏差被归因到水流品质——于是改进水流（多级漏壶平滑流量）优先于改进读数；误差的'外因优先'归因直接催生了仪器上游的技术进步
representative_cases_en: The sphere's daily comparison: after casting, 'the stars in the chamber answered the stars in heaven' — instrument and sky running side by side as routine engineering, not one-time acceptance; the first device in Chinese instrument history to write continuous calibration into its design goal

'Amend to follow heaven' in the calendar dispute: when the calendar drifted from the sky he urged revision, not defence — the reference (the heavens) outranks the history of using the reference (the old calendar); 'changing the calendar' was in his view not failure but the comparison mechanism working normally

The multi-stage clepsydra's compensation: deviations exposed by comparison were attributed to water quality — so improving the flow (staged clepsydras smoothing discharge) outranked improving the readings; outside-in attribution of error directly catalysed upstream instrument technology
modern_applications_zh: 模型与产品的'持续对表'：上线不是工程终点而是对表开始——为每个模型指定不可协商的参照系（真实用户行为、真实市场数据）并固定对表节律
误差归因的'外因优先'纪律：系统偏差先审计数据源与输入品质，再归因于模型与执行——避免把系统性问题错记为个人失误（也避免反向包庇）
KPI 的'当改从天'原则：当指标与真实目标脱节，改指标而非粉饰数据——参照系高于参照系的使用史
modern_applications_en: Standing comparison for models and products: launch is not the end of engineering but the start of comparison — give every model a non-negotiable reference (real user behaviour, real market data) and a fixed comparison rhythm
Outside-in attribution of error: audit data sources and input quality before blaming models and execution — keeping systemic problems from being mis-booked as personal failures (and vice versa)
'Amend to follow heaven' for KPIs: when a metric detaches from the true goal, change the metric rather than polish the data — the reference outranks the history of using it
representative_figures: 张衡（核心）
郭守敬（继承参照：授时历'以四海测验'——把对表的参照网络铺到全国规模）
约翰·哈里森（平行参照：航海钟以长期对表对抗经度漂移——同样把正确性定义为持续维护状态）

modes.name_en: The Method of Tracing Numbers to Their Source
modes.domain_zh: 定量推演方法论/对一切'被引用的数'追查其推导源头：圆周率不引旧说而自算（得约 3.1466），周天不采成数而自推（十万三千六百八十又十分之五），地球直径与天高皆以几何自求——数的权威来自推导链而非出处；推不出来的数宁可空着，也不沿用讲得通的旧数
modes.domain_en: Quantitative methodology / tracing every cited number to its derivation: pi not quoted from precedent but recomputed (to about 3.1466), the celestial circumference not adopted as received but derived (1,036,880.5), the earth's diameter and the height of heaven both sought by geometry — a number's authority comes from its derivation chain, not its citation; a number that cannot be derived is better left blank than carried forward because it sounds right
modes.definition_zh: 定量推演方法论/汉代数术的传统权威结构是'经有明文'：任何一个数（周天度数、天地尺度、圆方之率）只要能在经典里找到出处，就可以被引用千年；张衡在《灵宪》与浑天计算中的做法是把权威结构整个翻转——'天体圆如弹丸'的尺度不引《周髀》成数，而以立表测影与几何推演自求：他算得日月在径上各千里、周天十万三千六百八十又十分之五、圆周率取约 3.1466（祖冲之前两百年最精密的中国圆周率），每一个数都附带它的推导路径；这一方法的实质是给'数'建立与'事'同级的验证链：可验证的数自算，暂不可自算的数标注为估算并给出上下界——绝不沿用'讲得通但推不出'的旧数；他的推算在今天看来多不精确，但这不重要——重要的是每一步都以'推导'替代'引用'，让后继者可以逐级复核与推翻；方法论上要求：任何进入判断的数都要能给出'它从哪一步算来'，给不出的要么空着要么标注置信级，引用别人之数时引用的是推导链而非结论
modes.definition_en: Quantitative methodology / the traditional authority structure of Han numerology was 'the classics have explicit text': any number — degrees of the celestial circle, scale of heaven and earth, ratio of circle and square — once found in a classic could be cited for a thousand years; Zhang Heng's practice in the 'Ling Xian' and his armillary computations turned that structure over — the scale of 'the celestial body round as a pellet' was not quoted from the Zhoubi's received figures but sought by gnomon shadows and geometric derivation: he obtained sun and moon each a thousand li in diameter, a celestial circumference of 1,036,880.5, pi taken as about 3.1466 (the most precise Chinese value for two centuries before Zu Chongzhi) — every number accompanied by its derivation path; the essence is to give numbers the same verification chain as events: derivable numbers are recomputed, not-yet-derivable ones marked as estimates with bounds — never carry forward 'plausible but underivable' old numbers; his results look imprecise today, but that is beside the point — what matters is that each step substitutes derivation for citation, letting successors recheck and overturn level by level; methodologically: any number entering a judgment must show 'which step it was computed from'; those that cannot are left blank or confidence-graded, and when citing another's number one cites the derivation chain, not the conclusion
modes.source_chapter: 《灵宪》：'天体圆如弹丸……日月之径则千里'；刘徽注《九章》引张衡算：周天十万三千六百八十又十分之五，圆周率约合 3.1466。
modes.key_quote_zh: 引用来的数再精确也只是别人的影子——推不出来的数宁可空着，推得出来的数哪怕粗糙也带着整条可以复核的路。
modes.key_quote_en: A cited number, however precise, is only another's shadow — better leave blank what cannot be derived; what can be derived, though crude, carries the whole recheckable road.
key_concepts: 推导替代引用 derivation over citation（数的权威来自推导链——引用别人之数时引用的是路径而非结论）
derivation over citation (a number's authority is its derivation chain — citing another's number means citing the path, not the conclusion)
可复核性优先 recheckability first（结果宁可粗糙但要每步可复核——精确而不可复核的数是学术债务）
recheckability first (prefer crude but step-by-step recheckable; a precise uncheckable number is scholarly debt)
空位纪律 the discipline of the blank（推不出的数标注为估算并给出上下界，绝不沿用'讲得通但推不出'的旧数）
the discipline of the blank (underivable numbers are graded as estimates with bounds; never carry forward the plausible-but-underivable)
给后继者留推翻接口 leaving successors a lever（每一步推导都写成可以被逐级推翻的形式——科学的可积累性来自可推翻性）
leaving successors a lever (write each derivation so it can be overturned step by step — science accretes by being overturnable)
process_zh: 盘点判断中的全部'被引用数'：每个数标注其来源（自算/引用/成说/不明）——来源不明者立即隔离
对可自算者重建推导链：从原始测量与定义出发逐步重算，每步写出依据——重算结果与旧值不符时以重算为准
对不可自算者降级处理：标注为估算，给出上下界与依赖假设，禁止以'精确形式'出场
成文时数与推导同列：交付的每一个数都附带'从哪一步算来'——让读者复核的成本降到读一遍的成本
process_en: Inventory every cited number in a judgment: mark each as self-derived, cited, received lore, or unknown — unknowns quarantined at once

Rebuild derivation chains for the self-derivable: recompute step by step from raw measurement and definitions, each step with its ground; where recomputation and old value disagree, the recomputation rules
Downgrade the non-derivable: mark as estimate, give bounds and dependencies, forbid them from appearing in precise form
Publish number and derivation side by side: every delivered number carries 'which step it came from' — the reader's cost of rechecking falls to the cost of one reading
representative_cases_zh: 圆周率与周天的自算：刘徽注中保存的张衡推算——周天十万三千六百八十又十分之五、圆率约 3.1466，比前代'径一周三'精确一个量级；祖冲之前两百年中国最精密的圆周率，且带完整推导路径
《灵宪》的天地尺度推演：日月之径千里、天高八极之维皆以立表测影与几何自求——不引《周髀》成数；结论虽不精确，但每一步都是可复核的几何
历法之议中的数源坚持：反对以'先王旧数'定历，主张一切历数出于实测——数没有出处特权，只有推导特权
representative_cases_en: Pi and the celestial circumference self-computed: Zhang Heng's derivation preserved in Liu Hui's commentary — a circumference of 1,036,880.5 and pi about 3.1466, an order of magnitude beyond the received 'diameter one, circumference three'; the most precise Chinese pi two centuries before Zu Chongzhi, with the derivation path complete

The 'Ling Xian' derivation of heaven-and-earth scale: sun and moon a thousand li across, the dimensions of heaven sought by gnomon and geometry, not the Zhoubi's received figures — conclusions imprecise, but every step recheckable geometry

Standing on number-sources in the calendar debates: against settling the calendar by 'the ancestors' old numbers', all calendrical numbers from measurement — numbers hold no privilege of citation, only of derivation
modern_applications_zh: 商业模型的'数源审计'：每个进入汇报的数字标注'自算/引用/成说'——引用要带推导链（口径、样本、公式），成说一律隔离待验
技术团队的'可复核交付'：估算值必须带上下界与假设清单，精确形式仅留给可推导值——杜绝'精确但来历不明'的数字进入决策
个人学习的'重算法'：对流行结论中的关键数字亲手重算一遍——推导链跑通过一次的知识才真正属于自己
modern_applications_en: Number-source audits in business models: every number entering a deck tagged self-derived, cited, or lore — citations must carry their chain (calibre, sample, formula); lore quarantined pending test
Recheckable delivery in engineering teams: estimates carry bounds and assumption lists, precise form reserved for derivable values — keeping precise-but-untraceable numbers out of decisions
Recomputation in personal learning: recompute by hand the key figures in popular conclusions — only knowledge whose derivation chain has been run once truly belongs to you

modes.name_en: The Method of the Waiting Trigger
modes.category: 仪器设计方法论/被动感知
modes.domain_zh: 被动感知方法论/不追逐事件而让事件自己来扣动扳机：地动仪不是'监测地震'的主动系统而是'等地震撞上来'的被动机关——八条都中悬铜柱，静时不动、震时失恒，都柱一倾，龙机即发；感知装置的最高形态是把'探测'变成'等待'——装置无功耗地保持全神贯注
modes.domain_en: Instrument-design methodology / not chasing events but letting events pull their own trigger: the seismoscope is not an active system monitoring earthquakes but a passive mechanism waiting to be struck — eight suspended pendulums still when calm, broken from balance when the earth moves, and the least tilt of the pillar releases the dragon's mechanism; the highest form of a sensing device is to turn detection into waiting — a device holding its full attention at zero running cost
modes.definition_zh: 被动感知方法论/汉代没有'地震学'，张衡面对的问题边界清楚：地震波传播远快于驿马，但震感传播远慢于驿马——从震中到洛阳，大地先到，消息后到；地动仪的全部天才在于利用这个时间差：它不预测地震、不监测地震、不追逐地震，它只是把自己造成'大地比人先知道的任何事件都会在里面留下痕迹'的形状——中央都柱悬而不触，八个方向的龙机各衔一丸；大地平静时整个装置处于完美的不作为（零功耗、零误报），大地一动，某一方向的惯性失衡就自动完成'探测-定向-报信'三件事；这就是'候风触机'：像候风的帆一样等待，像弩机的悬刀一样触发——被动性不是能力不足，而是对'事件会自己上门'的深度信任；方法论上要求：识别'哪些信息会自己到达'（物理量会传过来、市场会用脚投票、当事人会自己开口），把装置的全部设计资源用于'把自己造成那些信息必然留下痕迹的形状'，并把静默期的不作为当作装置的正常工作状态而非故障
modes.definition_en: Instrument-design methodology / Han times had no 'seismology', and Zhang Heng's problem boundary was crisp: earthquake waves travel far faster than courier horses, but felt shaking travels far slower — from epicentre to Luoyang the earth arrives first and the news later; the whole genius of the seismoscope lies in exploiting that lag: it predicts no quake, monitors no quake, chases no quake — it is simply shaped so that any event the earth knows before men will leave its trace inside; the central pillar hangs without touching, the dragon mechanisms of eight directions each hold a ball; while the earth is calm the device rests in perfect inaction (zero power, zero false alarms), and when the earth moves, an inertial imbalance in one direction automatically completes detect, orient, report; this is 'waiting for the wind, triggered like the crossbow catch': waiting like a sail awaiting wind, firing like a crossbow's suspended blade — passivity is not incapacity but deep trust that events will call in person; methodologically: identify which information arrives of itself (physical quantities travel, markets vote with their feet, parties speak unprompted), spend the device's whole design budget on shaping itself so that information must leave its trace, and treat silence as the device's normal working state, not a fault
modes.source_chapter: 《后汉书·张衡传》：'中有都柱，傍行八道，施关发机……如有地动，尊则振龙，机发吐丸，而蟾蜍衔之。'
modes.key_quote_zh: 最灵的耳朵不是追着声音跑，而是把自己造成声音必然撞响的形状——大地知道的事，总会自己走进屋里来。
modes.key_quote_en: The keenest ear does not chase sounds but shapes itself so sounds must strike it — what the earth knows will always walk into the room of its own accord.
key_concepts: 被动全神贯注 passive attention（装置以零功耗保持对事件的全神贯注——等待是工作状态而非待机状态）
passive attention (the device holds full attention on events at zero running cost — waiting is a working state, not standby)
时间差套利 lag arbitrage（利用'大地先到、消息后到'的传播时差——装置的价值来自它站在时间差的上游）
lag arbitrage (exploiting the lag of earth-before-news — the device's worth lies in standing upstream of the difference)
事件自动定向 event as orientation（探测与定向交给事件的物理本身——都柱向哪倾，哪方就是答案，无需主动扫描）
the event as orientation (detecting and orienting are done by the event's physics — the direction the pillar tilts is the answer; no active scan needed)
静默即正常 silence as normal (静默期不作为是装置的完好状态——把'无事发生'当作成功而非故障，误报的代价远高于漏报的延迟)
silence as normal (inaction in quiet periods is the device's healthy state — 'nothing happened' is success not failure; a false alarm costs more than a delayed one)
process_zh: 识别自达信息：列出哪些信息会不请自来（物理信号、市场行为、当事人言行）——这些是被动装置的合法捕获物
设计触机形状：把全部设计资源用于'让自己被那些信息必然改变'——悬而待发、静而常醒，不添任何主动扫描动作
设置单次性触发：每个触发只报告一个事件并留下不可抹除的痕迹（落丸不可回收）——防止重复报告污染判断
把静默写进规格：明确'无触发的时段'的解读规则与检查节律——静默本身每周被检查一次，以确认装置仍在待发
process_en: List the self-arriving: name which information comes uninvited (physical signals, market behaviour, parties' own words) — the lawful catch of passive devices
Shape the trigger: spend the design budget on 'being changed by that information necessarily' — hanging ready, quiet and awake, adding no active scanning
Make triggers single-shot: each trigger reports one event and leaves an erasable-by-nothing trace (the dropped ball cannot be recalled) — preventing repeated reports from polluting judgment
Write silence into the spec: define the reading rules and inspection rhythm for triggerless periods — silence itself inspected weekly to confirm the device still hangs ready
representative_cases_zh: 候风地动仪的完整机关：都柱悬于仪中、八道施关发机——地震波过处某一方向惯性失衡，'机发吐丸，而蟾蜍衔之'，激扬声觉知而检其一向；一次触发、一个方向、不可撤销——138 年陇西验证的就是这套被动机关的完整性
'候风'二字的装置哲学：仪器名义上'候风'（候地气之风）而非'测震'——它对一切大地的异常脉动保持待发，不预设只有地震才值得报告；被动装置的感知面比主动扫描更宽
与浑天仪的互补：浑天仪主动运转（以水力追逐天象）、地动仪被动待发（以静默等待大地）——两台仪器合起来构成张衡的完整感知论：可预测者主动对表，不可预测者被动设伏
representative_cases_en: The complete mechanism of the seismoscope: the pillar hung within, eight channels with catches and releases — a passing wave tilts one direction's balance, 'the mechanism fires and drops the ball, and the toad holds it', the sound announcing and marking the one bearing; one trigger, one direction, irrevocable — what 138 verified was precisely the integrity of this passive mechanism

The device philosophy in the name 'houfeng': nominally the instrument 'awaits the wind' (the wind of terrestrial qi) rather than 'measures quakes' — it stands ready against any abnormal pulse of the earth, presuming no quake to be the only thing worth reporting; the passive device's sensor surface is wider than any active scan

Complementarity with the armillary sphere: the sphere actively turns (chasing the sky by water power), the seismoscope passively waits (lying in ambush for the earth in silence) — together they form Zhang Heng's complete theory of sensing: the predictable is actively compared, the unpredictable passively ambushed
modern_applications_zh: 风控的'被动陷阱'设计：不追逐欺诈而把自己造成欺诈必然撞响的形状（不可抹除的审计日志、单向触发警报）——静默期视为风控正常工作
产品与研究的'自达信号'清单：列出用户/市场/数据会自己送上门的信号并为其设计捕获形状——把预算从主动调研转向被动捕获结构
个人认知的'都柱悬置'：对无法预测的重大变量（行业地震、技术颠覆）不追逐预测，而设计'它一来我必然知道'的悬置机关（信息源布置、单次性警报）
modern_applications_en: Passive traps in risk control: do not chase fraud — shape yourself so fraud must ring you (tamper-evident audit logs, one-shot alerts), treating quiet periods as the control working properly

A self-arriving-signal inventory for products and research: list what users, markets and data deliver uninvited, and design capture shapes for them — shifting budget from active survey to passive capture structure

The suspended pillar in personal cognition: for great unpredictable variables (industry earthquakes, technological disruption) do not chase forecasts — rig the 'when it comes I cannot fail to know' mechanism (sensor placements, one-shot alerts)
representative_figures: 张衡（核心）
吴健雄时代的云室与气泡室（平行参照：以过饱和静置等待粒子自己撞出径迹——同样'被动全神贯注'的实验哲学）
塔勒布（理论呼应：以'凸性暴露'替代预测——被动装置正是对不可预测事件的最优暴露形状）

modes.name_en: The Method of Holding the Office
modes.category: 职业伦理/体制内科学家
modes.domain_zh: 体制内科学家职业伦理方法论/把'官职的边界'当作'知识的边界'来精确定义并据此行动：太史令职责内的事（天象、历法、地震、仪器）做到极致，职责外的事（经义争论、符命预测、政治站队）明确不做或只做'本官分内的发言'——两次出任同一九品官职而不求迁升，用二十年把一个冷曹署经营成帝国的科学机构
modes.domain_en: Professional ethics of the in-system scientist / defining the boundary of knowledge as the boundary of the office, precisely, and acting on it: within the Grand Historian's duties (celestial phenomena, calendar, earthquakes, instruments) to the utmost; outside them (classical disputes, omen predictions, political alignment) clearly declined or spoken only as the office itself may speak — twice serving in the same ninth-rank post without seeking promotion, spending twenty years turning a cold bureau into the empire's scientific institution
modes.definition_zh: 体制内科学家职业伦理方法论/张衡仕途的表面事实是'不显'：两度出任太史令、十四年不迁，时人谓其'去史官而迁侍中是升、复为太史令是降'，他以《应间》自辩'不患位之不尊，而患德之不崇'；但结构地看，太史令恰恰是他所有科学成就的容器：灵台（国家天文台）在此职掌下、观测记录在此职辖内、仪器制作在此职权限中——他把一个九品冷署经营成了东汉帝国的科学院；'守职法'的要义有三：其一，精确划界——哪些判断是'太史令有权说的话'（天象、历数、地震），哪些不是（谶纬的政治解读、储位废立），前者的发言权用足，后者的诱惑拒绝；其二，把职责内的制度性资源用满——灵台的观测网、国家的工匠体系、驿传的信息网，全部转化为科研基础设施；其三，不迁升本身就是策略——留在技术职位上二十年，比在仕途阶梯上流动更能积累深度；方法论上要求：为知识实践找到（或构造）一个制度容器，把容器内的权限用到边界，对容器外的发言只以'分内身份'出声
modes.definition_en: Professional ethics of the in-system scientist / the surface facts of Zhang Heng's career read as 'obscure': twice Grand Historian-Astrologer, fourteen years without promotion, contemporaries holding that to leave the historians' office for palace attendant was rise, to return was fall — he answered in the 'Yingjian': 'I worry not about rank's lack of honour but about virtue's lack of grandeur'; but structurally, the office was the vessel of every scientific achievement he made: the Lingtai observatory fell under this post, the observation records within its purview, instrument-making within its writ — he ran a ninth-rank bureau into the Eastern Han's academy of sciences; the method has three parts: first, precise boundary-drawing — which judgments 'the Grand Historian may speak' (sky, calendar, quake) and which not (political reading of omens, deposition of heirs): the former's voice used to the full, the latter's temptation refused; second, exhausting the institutional resources within the duties — the Lingtai's observing network, the state's artisan system, the courier information web, all converted into research infrastructure; third, non-promotion itself as strategy — twenty years in a technical post accumulate more depth than any climb up the career ladder; methodologically: find (or build) an institutional vessel for knowledge practice, use the vessel's mandate to its boundary, and outside it speak only in the persona the office itself allows
modes.source_chapter: 《后汉书·张衡传》：'衡不慕当世，所居之官辄积年不徙。自去史职，五载复还'；《应间》：'不患位之不尊，而患德之不崇；不耻禄之不夥，而耻智之不博。'
modes.key_quote_zh: 职位不是要爬的梯子，是要住的房子——住得够久，冷署也能住成科学院；分内的发言权用足，分外的诱惑一个不接。
modes.key_quote_en: A post is not a ladder to climb but a house to live in — live in it long enough and a cold bureau becomes an academy; speak to the full within the office's writ, and accept none of the temptations outside it.
key_concepts: 知识边界即职权边界 knowledge boundary as office boundary（'我有权说什么'与'我知道什么'同一定义——越权的知识发言败坏两个领域）
knowledge boundary as office boundary ('what may I say' defined identically to 'what do I know' — out-of-writ speech corrupts both realms)
冷署经营法 running the cold bureau（制度容器内的资源用满用尽——观测网、工匠、驿传皆为科研基础设施）
running the cold bureau (exhaust the resources inside the institutional vessel — observing nets, artisans, couriers all become research infrastructure)
不迁升策略 non-promotion as strategy（留在技术岗位的长期性本身就是积累深度的方式——流动的仕途换不回连续的二十年的台站）
non-promotion as strategy (longevity in the technical post is itself how depth accumulates — a mobile career cannot buy back twenty continuous years at a station)
分外发言的分内化 in-writ framing of out-of-writ matters（职责外的诱惑若无法拒绝，则只以'本官职分'的形式回应——以仪器讲地震，不以太史令讲废立）

in-writ framing of out-of-writ matters (temptations outside the duties, if unavoidable, answered only in the office's own form — speak of quakes with instruments, never of succession as Grand Historian)
process_zh: 精确划界：写出'本职位有权判断什么'的清单——清单内的事用足发言权与资源，清单外的事默认沉默
盘点容器资源：把职辖内的一切制度性资源（网络、人员、经费、信息渠道）逐项转化为知识生产的输入
以长期性换取深度：在技术岗位上的连续时间被当作资产经营——拒绝以迁升换取失去连续性
越界事务的分内化处理：无法回避的职责外议题，只用本职的语言与工具回应（以数据议历，不以天象议政）
process_en: Draw the precise boundary: write the list of 'what this post is entitled to judge' — within it, voice and resources to the full; outside it, silence by default
Inventory the vessel's resources: convert every institutional asset within the purview (networks, staff, funds, channels) into inputs of knowledge production
Trade longevity for depth: treat continuous time in the technical post as an asset, refusing promotions that would break continuity
Frame out-of-writ matters in-writ: unavoidable extraneous issues answered only in the office's language and tools — argue calendars with data, never politics with omens
representative_cases_zh: 两度太史令的机构经营：115-120、126-133 两任合计近二十年——灵台观测体系、历法修订、地动仪与浑天仪全部在此职任内完成；一个九品官职成为东汉科学的全部硬件载体
《应间》的自辩与划界：面对'才高于世而无骄尚之情'与仕途不迁的讥评，他自陈价值序列'德崇于位、智博于禄'——把守职的选择论证为价值观而非失败
晚年的两次越界与代价：任侍中时面对顺帝问'天下所疾恶者'，宦官惧其毁己皆嗔目而视，他'诡对而出'作《思玄赋》——分外的问题以文学形式（而非太史令职权）回应；出为河间相后以'治威严'整肃豪右——权在外任时以职权内的手段完成清整
representative_cases_en: Two terms as Grand Historian: 115-120 and 126-133, near twenty years combined — the Lingtai observing system, calendar revisions, the seismoscope and armillary all accomplished within this one post; a ninth-rank office carrying all the hardware of Eastern Han science

The 'Yingjian' self-defence and boundary: mocked for gifts beyond his age yet no promotion, he declared his value order — virtue over rank, breadth of mind over breadth of purse — arguing the choice of holding the office as values, not failure

The two late breaches and their costs: as palace attendant, asked by Emperor Shun 'what the realm most hates', with eunuchs glaring he 'answered evasively and withdrew' to write the 'Rhapsody on Mysterious Speculation' — out-of-writ questions answered in literary form, not by the Grand Historian's writ; later as chancellor of Hejian he cleansed the clans by 'stern authority' — power outside, means strictly within the office held
modern_applications_zh: 科研与技术岗位的'容器选择'：选制度容器时优先看'职权边界与知识边界是否重合'——重合度高的冷署优于错位的热职
组织内专家的'分内发言权用足'：职权内的专业判断全部正式发声并留档，职权外议题默认以'仅代表专业视角'的形式有限参与
职业规划的'长期台站'策略：技术深耕型职业者把'连续在岗时间'当一级资产——迁升的机会成本按'失去的台站连续性'计价
modern_applications_en: Choosing the vessel for research and technical careers: prefer the institution whose mandate boundary coincides with the knowledge boundary — a cold bureau well-aligned beats a hot post misaligned

Using the in-writ voice to the full for in-house experts: every professional judgment within the mandate voiced formally and archived; out-of-mandate topics by default limited to 'professional view only' participation
The long-station strategy in career planning: deep technical professionals treat continuous time in post as a first-order asset — promotion's opportunity cost priced as lost station continuity

钱学森（平行参照：以体制职位经营'总体设计部'——制度容器内的系统工程传统）

modes.name_en: The Method of Following Heaven, Not Men
modes.domain_zh: 专业自主方法论/在'专业判断'与'权力意志'冲突时，把裁决权明确移交给客观参照而非在场权力：历法之议中他主张'历数差错，当改从天'——改历的依据是天象实测而非政治需要、多数意见或祖制成规；专业人士的全部尊严在于：可以服从权力的人事安排，但绝不服从权力的事实认定
modes.domain_en: Professional autonomy methodology / when professional judgment and the will of power conflict, explicitly handing adjudication to the objective reference rather than the power present: in the calendar disputes he held 'when the reckoning errs, amend it to follow heaven' — the ground for changing the calendar is measured sky, not political need, majority opinion or ancestral precedent; the whole dignity of the professional lies here: one may obey power's arrangements of persons, but never power's determinations of fact
modes.definition_zh: 专业自主方法论/东汉历法之争的结构是：历数（专业判断）与历政（权力需要）长期互相拉扯——改历牵动'正朔'这一王朝合法性符号，因此每次改历都是政治事件；张衡参与议历时确立的立场是把这个结构拆开：历法的唯一参照系是天象，'天之历数'不因改朝而改、不因君意而移——'历数差错，当改从天'的完整含义是：发现偏差（对表）、依据实测改历（专业判断）、拒绝以政治便利为改历理由（划界）；这是'从天不从人'：不是对抗权力（他从不抗命），而是把事实认定权从权力手里拿走——权力可以决定改不改的时机，不能决定天象的内容；更深一层，这一立场与他'请禁图谶'是同一件事的两面：图谶是'以圣人名义发布的事实'，历政是'以朝廷名义认定的事实'——两者都试图用权威替代实测，两者都被他移交回客观参照；方法论上要求：在专业领域内预先声明唯一参照系，把'何时改'的时机权留给权力、把'改什么'的内容权锁死在参照系上，并以本职工具（数据、仪器、推导）作为唯一发言介质
modes.definition_en: Professional autonomy methodology / the structure of Eastern Han calendar disputes was a long tug between calendrical reckoning (professional judgment) and calendar-politics (power's needs) — to change the calendar moved the 'correct epoch', a symbol of dynastic legitimacy, so every revision was a political event; Zhang Heng's position in the debates took this structure apart: the calendar's sole reference is the sky, 'the reckoning of heaven' changing with no dynasty and shifting with no prince — the full meaning of 'when the reckoning errs, amend it to follow heaven': detect the deviation (comparison), amend by measurement (professional judgment), refuse political convenience as a reason (boundary); this is 'following heaven, not men' — not defying power (he never disobeyed an order) but taking the determination of fact out of power's hands: power may decide the timing of change, never the content of the sky; deeper, this stance and his petition against the apocrypha are two faces of one thing: the apocrypha were 'facts issued in the sages' name', calendar-politics 'facts determined in the court's name' — both tried to substitute authority for measurement, and both he handed back to the objective reference; methodologically: declare the sole reference in advance within the professional domain, leave power the timing of change, lock the content of change to the reference, and speak only through the tools of the craft (data, instruments, derivations)
modes.source_chapter: 《后汉书·张衡传》历议语境；张衡议历主张'历数差错，当改从天'；参《请禁绝图谶疏》同一立场：'谶纬非圣人之法'。
modes.key_quote_zh: 权力可以决定何时改，不能决定天上是什么——专业人士的全部底线就一条：人事可以服从，事实认定不服从。
modes.key_quote_en: Power may decide when to change; it cannot decide what is in the sky — the professional's whole bottom line is one: obey arrangements of persons, never determinations of fact.
key_concepts: 事实认定权独立 the independence of fact-determination（把'天象是什么'从权力手里收回——权力保留时机权、丧失内容权）
the independence of fact-determination (take 'what the sky shows' back from power — power keeps the timing, loses the content)
唯一参照系声明 declaring the sole reference（专业领域预先声明唯一参照（天象、数据、基准）——参照系不接受现场协商）
declaring the sole reference (the reference — sky, data, benchmark — declared in advance; it accepts no on-the-spot negotiation)
不抗命的自主 autonomy without defiance（从不抗命——把自主藏在'何时改'与'改什么'的分离里：服从安排、守住内容）
autonomy without defiance (never disobeying — autonomy hidden in the separation of 'when to change' from 'what to change': obey the arrangement, hold the content)
本职工具发言 speaking through the craft（以数据、仪器、推导为唯一发言介质——专业自主的语法是工具的语法，不是情绪的语法）
speaking through the craft (data, instruments, derivations as the only medium — the grammar of professional autonomy is the grammar of tools, not of emotion)
process_zh: 预先声明参照系：在专业介入开始时书面声明'本领域以何为裁决'——参照系声明本身就是最重要的专业行为
拆分时机与内容：把'何时改'（可协商、可服从）与'改什么'（不可协商、锁死参照系）在流程上明确分离
以工具发言：一切专业主张以数据、推导、仪器读数为载体出场——拒绝以资历、情绪或忠诚为专业主张背书
接受时机服从：对时机安排的服从是职业伦理的一部分——但每次服从后立即记录'内容未被改变'的证据
process_en: Declare the reference in advance: at the start of professional engagement, state in writing what adjudicates in this domain — the declaration itself is the primary professional act
Split timing from content: separate 'when to change' (negotiable, obedient) from 'what to change' (non-negotiable, locked to the reference) explicitly in process
Speak through tools: present every professional claim in data, derivations, instrument readings — never backed by seniority, emotion or loyalty
Accept obedience of timing: obeying timing arrangements is part of professional ethics — but after each obedience, log the evidence that the content was not altered
representative_cases_zh: 历法之议的'当改从天'：参与汉安帝、顺帝朝历议时坚持历法唯一参照是天象实测——反对以谶纬定历、反对以祖制成数护历；改历的时机由朝廷定，改历的内容只由天定
请禁图谶的同一立场：图谶宣称提供'关于天意的事实'，张衡以文献学证明其来源伪造——把'天意的事实认定'从谶家手里收回交还给可验证的观测与经典
地动仪对宦官政治的隐喻：138 年之后'验之以事'成为朝廷共识——事实由事件而非由在场权力认定，这一先例被写进了《后汉书》而流传
representative_cases_en: The 'amend to follow heaven' of the calendar debates: through the reigns of An and Shun he held the calendar's sole reference to be measured sky — against settling it by apocrypha, against shielding it by ancestral numbers; the court set the timing of change, only heaven set its content

The same stance in petitioning against the apocrypha: the apocrypha claimed to provide 'facts about heaven's intent'; he proved their sources forged by philology — taking the determination of heaven's intent from the augurs and returning it to testable observation and the classics

The seismoscope as metaphor for court politics: after 138, 'letting events judge' became court consensus — facts determined by events, not by the power present; a precedent written into the Book of the Later Han and transmitted
modern_applications_zh: 技术团队的'参照系契约'：项目启动时书面声明'本系统的仲裁标准是哪个数据/哪个基准'——上级保留优先级权、丧失技术内容权
专业顾问的'时机-内容'分离：接受客户对'何时做'的全部安排，'做什么与标准是什么'锁死在专业基准——每次妥协后留档'内容未变'的证明
个人职场底线的'从天不从人'：绩效评级、晋升时机可以接受组织安排，但'技术事实是什么'的发言权不随层级让渡——用数据与推导说话并留下书面记录
modern_applications_en: The reference contract for technical teams: at kickoff, declare in writing which data or benchmark adjudicates the system — superiors keep priority-setting, lose technical content

Timing-content separation for professional advisers: accept the client's full control of 'when', lock 'what and by what standard' to the professional benchmark — file proof of unaltered content after each compromise

'Following heaven, not men' as a personal workplace bottom line: ratings and promotion timing may follow organisational arrangements, but the right to say what the technical facts are is never surrendered to hierarchy — speak by data and derivation, leave written records
representative_figures: 张衡（核心）
希帕恰斯（平行参照：以观测精度对抗宇宙论权威——把'天象内容权'从学派手里收回）
竺可桢（平行参照：以'求是'立所训——现代中国'事实认定不从权'的制度化延续）

modes.name_en: The Method of Inner Reflection in Dark Speculation
modes.domain_zh: 精神自处方法论/当外部方法全部失效（讽谏无门、禁谶不行、仕途不迁），把探索的装置转向内部：《思玄赋》以远游求索、问卜天地、观星自省的完整仪式完成自我诊断——'玄'是幽深不明处，'思玄'即是在看不清的地方继续思考；内照不是逃避而是方法的最后一段：在不可改的处境里完成对自己的实测
modes.domain_en: Method of the spirit / when every outer method fails (admonition doorless, prohibition of omens unheeded, promotion frozen), turning the instrument of exploration inward: the 'Rhapsody on Mysterious Speculation' completes a full rite of self-diagnosis — visionary journey, questions to oracle and heaven, self-inspection among the stars; 'xuan' is the deep and dim, and 'thinking the xuan' is continuing to think where seeing is unclear; inner reflection is not escape but the method's final stretch: conducting a real measurement of oneself inside an unchangeable situation
modes.definition_zh: 精神自处方法论/张衡晚年的处境是方法论者的绝境样本：地动仪已验证而朝政日非，禁谶之疏已上而不行，讽谏的赋体已尽而宦官用事——《思玄赋》是他对这绝境的方法论回应：全文以'我该怎么继续'为题，先问卜（'占既吉而无悔兮'）、再远游（上天下地遍访先贤）、终归于观星自省（'揽争弯之己曲兮'）——结构上正是他一切外在方法（预言-验证-对表）的内化版本：向内的'占卜'是对自己动机的对表，向外的'远游'是对前辈样本的检索，最终的'观星'是在不可改的坐标系里重新定位自己；这一方法的实质是把'对表的验收标准'从外部事件转移到内部一致性：外部世界拒绝被改进时，改进的对象切换为'自己与自己的关系'——志向与处境、知识与位置、坚守与代价三组关系的持续校准；方法论上要求：在外部方法失效时明确切换探索方向（而非重复失效的方法），以内省完成对自己的实测并写下记录，把内照的结论作为外部策略的输入而非替代
modes.definition_en: Method of the spirit / Zhang Heng's late situation is the methodologist's specimen of despair: the seismoscope verified yet the court darkening, the memorial against omens filed and unheeded, the fu of admonition exhausted while eunuchs ruled — the 'Rhapsody on Mysterious Speculation' is his methodological answer to that dead end: taking 'how shall I continue' as its theme, it first puts a question to the oracle ('the divination auspicious and without regret'), then journeys far (heaven and earth, visiting the worthies of old), and returns at last to self-inspection among the stars — in structure the internalised version of all his outer methods (predict, verify, compare): the inward 'divination' is a comparison against his own motives, the outward 'journey' a search of predecessor samples, the final 'stargazing' a repositioning of himself within an unalterable frame of reference; the method's essence is shifting the acceptance criterion of comparison from outer events to inner consistency: when the outer world refuses improvement, the object of improvement switches to the relation of self to self — three pairs continuously calibrated: aspiration against situation, knowledge against position, constancy against cost; methodologically: when outer methods fail, switch the direction of exploration explicitly (never repeat the failed method), complete a real measurement of oneself through reflection and write it down, and take the conclusions of inner reflection as input to outer strategy, not its replacement
modes.source_chapter: 《思玄赋》：'仰先哲之玄训兮，虽弥高其弗违……'；序云'衡常思图身之事，以为吉凶倚伏，幽微难明，乃作《思玄赋》以宣寄情志'。
modes.key_quote_zh: 外面的仪器到不了的地方，自己就是最后的仪器——思玄不是退却，是方法在不可改的坐标系里给自己做的一次实测。
modes.key_quote_en: Where the outer instruments cannot reach, the self is the last instrument — thinking the xuan is not retreat but the method's real measurement of itself, in a frame of reference that cannot be changed.
key_concepts: 方法的内化 internalisation of method（预言-验证-对表转向内部版本——向内占卜即动机对表，向内远游即样本检索）
internalisation of method (predict-verify-compare turned inward — inner divination as motive comparison, inner journey as sample search)
不可改坐标系中的定位 positioning in the unalterable frame（处境不可改时，任务从'改处境'切换为'在坐标系里重新定位自己'）
positioning in the unalterable frame (when the situation cannot change, the task switches from changing it to relocating oneself within the frame)
内照有记录 reflection with a record（自我实测必须成文——思玄写成赋而非日记：内省的结论以可传递的形式交付）
reflection with a record (self-measurement must be written — the xuan made a rhapsody, not a diary: inner conclusions delivered in transmissible form)
内照为外用 reflection as input to action（内照结论回流为外部策略输入而非替代行动——思玄之后仍有河间相的清整）
reflection as input to action (inner conclusions flow back as input to outer strategy, not its replacement — after the xuan still came the cleansing of Hejian)
process_zh: 识别方法失效：明确列出哪些外部方法已穷尽（讽谏、上疏、守职）——失效清单是切换探索方向的合法依据
向内对表：把外部方法逐一内化——对动机占卜（我为何坚持）、对样本检索（前人如何在同类绝境自处）、对处境定位（我不可改的坐标是什么）
成文交付：以内省结论写成可传递的作品（文章、信件、复盘）——不成文的内省会蒸发，成文的内省才是实测
回流外部策略：把内照结论转化为下一步外部行动的参数（如接受外任、改换体裁）——内照是输入，不是避难所
process_en: Identify method failure: list explicitly which outer methods are exhausted (admonition, memorials, holding the post) — the failure list is the lawful warrant for switching direction

Compare inward: internalise each outer method — divine one's motives (why do I persist), search predecessor samples (how did the ancients live this dead end), locate one's position (what coordinates cannot be changed)
Deliver in writing: render the reflective conclusions as a transmissible work (essay, letter, review) — unwritten introspection evaporates; written, it is a real measurement
Flow back into strategy: convert the reflective conclusions into parameters of the next outer move (accepting the provincial post, changing genre) — reflection is input, not shelter
representative_cases_zh: 《思玄赋》的完整内照结构：问卜（吉而无悔）→远游（上叩天阍、下历四海、遍访孔子、老聃、屈原之属）→观星自省（最后收回于'己'）——顺帝朝宦官嗔目逼问后的'诡对而出'，以一篇赋完成对自身处境的完整实测
《归田赋》的内照出口：思玄之后，他把'不可改'读得更清楚——仲春之时草木原隰，遂以史上第一篇成熟的抒情小赋宣布退出铺陈与待发：'苟纵心于物外，安知荣辱之所如'——内照的结论直接变成生活方式的改写
河间相的知行回流：内照并未导致隐退——136 年出为河间相，以职权内的'治威严'整肃王国豪右，'上下肃然'；内照的结论（自己在不可改坐标系里的位置）恰好支持了这次外任：方法闭环于行动
representative_cases_en: The complete inner structure of the 'Rhapsody on Mysterious Speculation': the oracle (auspicious, without regret), the far journey (heaven's gate, the four seas, visits to Confucius, Laozi, Qu Yuan), the self-inspection among the stars (at last returning to the self) — after the eunuchs' glaring interrogation and his 'evasive answer', one rhapsody completing a full measurement of his own position

The exit of the 'Rhapsody on Returning to the Fields': after the xuan he read 'the unalterable' more clearly — mid-spring, plants on the plain, and in the first mature lyric fu announced his withdrawal from unfolding and waiting: 'let the heart range beyond things; who knows where honour and disgrace have gone' — the reflective conclusion rewriting his way of life directly

The knowledge-action reflux of Hejian: reflection led to no hermitage — in 136 out as chancellor of Hejian, cleansing the kingdom's clans by in-office stern authority, 'all above and below in awe'; the reflective conclusion (his position in the unalterable frame) precisely supported this outer post: the method closing its loop in action
modern_applications_zh: 职业绝境的'思玄三步'：列出已失效的外部方法清单→完成对自身动机/样本/坐标的书面复盘→把复盘结论转化为下一步行动参数（转岗、换体裁、接受外派）
组织的'内照-回流'机制：重大挫折后以成文复盘（而非情绪宣泄）完成对自己的实测——复盘结论进入下阶段战略输入
个人的'不可改坐标系'练习：每年一次明确写出自己不可改的约束与可改的变量——把精力从'改不动的事'整体迁移到'坐标系内的重新定位'
modern_applications_en: The xuan three steps for career dead ends: list the exhausted outer methods, complete a written review of one's motives, samples and coordinates, convert the conclusions into parameters of the next move (transfer, genre change, accepting the field assignment)

An inner-reflection-with-reflux mechanism for organisations: after major setbacks, a written review (not emotional venting) completes the real measurement of oneself — its conclusions feeding the next phase's strategy

A yearly 'unalterable frame' exercise: once a year, write down explicitly one's unchangeable constraints and changeable variables — migrating energy wholesale from 'what cannot be moved' to 'repositioning within the frame'
representative_figures: 张衡（核心）
屈原（对照参照：《远游》的求索结构——思玄赋的直系文体祖先，但屈原终于沉江而张衡终于河间相：同一方法的不同行动出口）
苏东坡（平行参照：黄州之后的内照与回流——同样以成文内省完成自我实测并把结论化为生活改写）
